name: Income Verification Request
summary: Requests documents that support the income used in a tax assessment, refund review, or credit check.

guidance.primaryNextStep: Respond before the deadline even if you only have part of the file; attach a note explaining what is still coming.
guidance.deadlineSummary: By the date printed on the letter
guidance.appliesWhen: the Tax Authority sees a mismatch or needs more proof for income, credits, or a refund review
guidance.recommendedChannel: Submit the documents through the tax portal or office channel named on the letter.
guidance.whenToContactAuthority: the request refers to the wrong tax year, wrong taxpayer, or documents you cannot reasonably provide
guidance.whatToVerify: Verify the tax year, case number, discrepancy described, and the deadline for replying.

sections.explainer: Tax year and case number — identifies which filing period or review the request belongs to. Keep both numbers in front of you before you respond.
Requested proofs — commonly Form 106, payslips, invoicing records, pension statements, or bank confirmations that support the declared income.
sections.actionRequired: Prepare clear copies of every document listed; incomplete submissions often trigger another demand.

sections.explainer: Reporting discrepancy — this section usually hints at the mismatch they noticed, such as income reported by an employer that does not match your return.
sections.actionRequired: Write down your explanation before you respond so the documents and your written note tell the same story.

sections.explainer: Response deadline — the date by which the Tax Authority expects the documents or explanation. Missing it can delay a refund or cause the assessment to stand as-is.
sections.actionRequired: Respond before the deadline even if you only have part of the file; attach a note explaining what is still coming.
sections.deadline: By the date printed on the letter

sections.explainer: Submission channel — may direct you to the personal tax portal, secure email, or the local assessing office. The notice sometimes names a specific clerk or office code.
sections.actionRequired: Send the material through the exact channel listed and keep the submission confirmation.
